name: Knowledge scan
description: Three times a week (Sunday, Tuesday and Thursday at 06:00 Dubai) the Knowledge Researcher scans the web for every knowledge category and topic the CBO chose on Knowledge Watch, and files dated, sourced news items. Nothing is sent: the items wait for the weekly digest, and are on the Knowledge Watch screen. Needs a web search provider in Settings.

steps.name: Scan the web for each category
steps.description: The Knowledge Researcher searches each category that is on and files what it found through the plugin.
steps.instruction: Follow the knowledge-scan Skill: call `knowledge_watch_scan_brief`; if it lists no category reply NOTHING DUE. Otherwise scan each category with `web_search` and `read_page`, using each topic's own search terms, and file each one with `knowledge_watch_save_items`, with an empty list when nothing new was found. If you cannot search, call `knowledge_watch_report_problem` first. Write nothing any other way. Report one line per category.
